messages:
Sam: FYI — int4 canary rolled to 10% this morning and we're seeing a jump in labeler disagreement on the prompt bank :eyes:
Jaya: saw the alert. disagreement rate up ~12% vs baseline? numbers?
Marta: I pulled a quick diff, most regressions are in multi-turn code-rewrite prompts (longer context). looks like truncation + numeric instability in int4 path
Devon: oof. can we route canary traffic to a separate label queue? current labeler workers are mixing canary + prod and that inflates noise
Sam: good point. want to gate canary samples into a separate queue and smaller batch size for labelers. also add a flag so labelers know these are canary items
Jaya: agree. propose: 1) tag canary inputs with metadata: canary=true 2) introduce sampling throttle to limit canary labeling to 5% of throughput 3) run a focused golden update for the affected prompt families
Marta: sample throttle config (proposal):
```
sampling: {
  canary_bucket: 0.05,
  max_per_minute: 20,
  priority: low
}
```
Devon: will need labeler-queue change + small UI flag so annotators see "CANARY - do not escalate unless clear regression"
oncall-ml: tagging oncall for infra/reactive monitoring — will watch latency and pod OOMs from int4 runtime
Sam: also want to run a mini-eval comparing fp16 vs int4 on the prompt families that regressed. if quality delta > 5% we pause until fix or fallback
Jaya: I can assemble the eval set. suggest we pick 300 examples across 3 buckets: code-rewrite, multi-turn summarization, long-context Q&A
Marta: I'll do a quick diagnostic of KV-cache behavior in int4. suspect rounding errors when cache reuse + long ctx
Devon: I'll add routing rule to the serving layer: canary -> dedicated canary model pool (no mixing with prod pools) and fallback path fn that returns fp16 when heuristic triggers (e.g., score drop)
label-bot: automated: created queue "label-canary-int4-3367890123" and assigned initial capacity 10 workers
Sam: thanks — next steps: Jaya create eval set by EOD, Marta KV debug, Devon add routing + UI flag, I'll draft a short note to labelers explaining the canary tag and expectations
Jaya: will also add hidden control group of fp16 samples interleaved so we can measure true delta
Devon: ping me when routing rule is live and I'll flip the throttle to 5%
oncall-ml: monitoring hooks added to SLO dashboard (int4-canary.latency, int4-canary.token-err-rate)
Marta: quick question — do we want to include a small golden refresh? might need 50 new gold items focused on the broken families
Sam: yes, do it. label-bot can reserve a micro-golden batch and mark as high-priority for adjudication
label-bot: reserved 50 golden slots in "golden-canary-3367890123"
Sam: great. we'll reconvene in 2 hours for initial signals. thanks all :thumbsup:
